PRINCIPLE: Tests should focus on a single requirement/behavior with one Arrange-Act-Assert. RATIONALE: Isolates root causes and improves readability. (2) Test name does not suggest multiple operations. (3) There is a single Arrange-Act-Assert flow (setup, call, expect exception). VERDICT: compliant because the method performs a single operation (antecessor) and asserts its exceptional behavior in one logical block.

PRINCIPLE: Tests must not depend on other tests; use setup/teardown if needed. RATIONALE: Ensures deterministic independent execution. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for @Before/@After or shared mutable state. DECISION RULES: (1) No @Before/@After annotations found in the snippet. (2) The test uses only local variables (grafo0, agmPrim0) and does not modify static/instance state. VERDICT: compliant because the test uses only local state and does not rely on other tests or shared mutable state.
